resources.string:
• The cube is shown as an unfolded net with 6 faces.
 • Swipe on a face to rotate it, or use the move buttons (U, D, F, B, L, R).
 • ' means counterclockwise (e.g. U' = U counterclockwise).
 • Goal: make each face one solid color.
 • U=Up D=Down F=Front B=Back L=Left R=Right
 • Tap Shuffle to start a new scramble.
